segments.normalizedSource: ```c struct stat fileStat; if (stat(yourFilePath, &fileStat) == 0) { if ((fileStat.st_flags & SF_DATALESS) > 0) { // The file is dataless. } else { // The file isn't dataless. // SF_DATALESS is a feature of APFS; // don't assume IO is local here because network IO can happen on NFS. } } ```
segments.contextBefore: Check if a file is dataless and then only access it in a safe context. To do the check, call `stat` or `getattrlist` and examine if `SF_DATALESS` is present in `stat.st_flags`. Be aware that `stat` and `getattrlist` both trigger the materialization of any intermediate folders in the file’s path, if they themselves are dataless.
segments.contextAfter: Opt-out of dataless file materialization on a per-thread (or per-process) basis.
